intro: Gemini Assistant is good at phone jobs: call Mom, set a timer, play music, answer a quick question. Nobody disputes that. The confusion starts when people expect it to do work jobs. Inside Gmail it can summarize threads and answer inbox questions, but it cannot brief you for a meeting or keep a project moving across Slack, Notion, and email. GAIA lives in that gap. It manages the workday across your tools while your phone assistant keeps handling the phone.
